content.title: How to watch Duke-St. John’s Friday night: Tipoff time, TV info, streaming
content.text: Skip to contentCHARLOTTE, N.C. (WBTV) - No. 1 seed Duke and No. 5 seed St. John’s face off Friday night in the NCAA Tournament’s Sweet 16.The teams are set to tip off at 7:10 p.m. Friday, March 27, with a spot in the Elite Eight on the line.How to watchYou can watch locally on WBTV (CBS, Channel 3).Subscribers can also stream on Paramount+ or watch through their cable provider and streaming services such as YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, and Fubo.--> Also read: Hornets retire Dell Curry’s No. 30 jersey during halftime ceremony in CharlotteCopyright 2026 WBTV.
